福爾摩沙小導遊臺南 Tainan・東區

東區夜市與在地食堂Night Markets and Local Eats

該補充體力了！來東區吃吧。大東夜市在林森路，週一、週二、週五開市。台南的夜市是輪流開的，在地人用七字口訣背時刻表。「大大武花大武花」：週一到週日依序是大東、大東、武聖、花園、大東、武聖、花園。把口訣教給客人，保證他們再也不會撲空。成大商圈的勝利早點，是一代代成大人念念不忘的學生食堂。燒餅、油條與豆漿，一路賣到深夜。想正式吃一頓，就到詹記家常飯桌鮮魚湯 —— 東區最新的必比登推介。魚販第二代重現「飯桌仔」：十幾道家常菜一字排開，指哪道吃哪道！招牌鮮魚湯以鱸魚骨打底，加蛤蜊與現切魚片，現點現做。

Time to refuel! Let's eat in the East District. Dadong Night Market is on Linsen Road. It opens on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday. Tainan's night markets rotate through the week, and locals memorize the schedule with a seven-syllable chant. Da, da, wu, hua, da, wu, hua. From Monday to Sunday: Dadong, Dadong, Wusheng, Huayuan, Dadong, Wusheng, Huayuan. Teach it to your guests, and they will never miss a market night again. Around NCKU is Shengli Breakfast, the students' canteen that generations of NCKU alumni still dream about. Sesame flatbread, fried crullers, and soy milk, served into the small hours. For a proper meal, try Zhan-ji Fresh Fish Table, the East District's newest Bib Gourmand. A fishmonger's son revives the rice table: a dozen home dishes laid out. Point at what you want! The signature fish soup has sea-bass bones, clams, and fresh fillets, made to order.

一分鐘看懂

One-minute intro

為什麼值得來

Why it matters & history

東區是台南的大學城與生活區。逛累了，這裡有輪流開張的大東夜市、成大學生念念不忘的勝利早點，還有必比登推介的家常飯桌與鮮魚湯，是吃在地小吃的好地方。

The East District is Tainan's university and neighborhood area. It has the rotating Dadong Night Market, a beloved late-night breakfast shop for students, and a home-style fish soup restaurant recommended by the Michelin Bib Gourmand.

  1. 每週 Every week大東夜市在林森路，週一、週二、週五開市。The Dadong Night Market on Linsen Road opens on Mondays, Tuesdays and Fridays.
  2. 導覽員小提醒 Guide's tip記住口訣「大大武花大武花」，就知道每晚哪個夜市開。Learn the local rhyme and you will always know which night market is open.

認識景點

About the place

夜市：晚上的街頭市集。台南的夜市輪流開。 大東夜市：在林森路的夜市，週一、二、五開市。 輪流：。夜市在一週中輪流開。 口訣：有節奏的句子。在地人用七字口訣背夜市時刻表。

night market: A street market at night. Tainan's night markets rotate through the week. Dadong Night Market: A night market on Linsen Road. It opens on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday. rotate: To take turns. The night markets rotate through the week. chant: Words said in a rhythm. Locals memorize the market schedule with a seven-syllable chant.

武聖夜市：口訣裡的「武」是武聖，週三和週六。 花園夜市：口訣裡的「花」是花園，週四和週日。 勝利早點：成大商圈的學生食堂，一代代成大人念念不忘。 燒餅：撒著芝麻的餅。勝利早點一路賣到深夜。

Wusheng Night Market: In the chant, wu stands for Wusheng. It opens on Wednesday and Saturday. Huayuan Night Market: In the chant, hua stands for Huayuan. It opens on Thursday and Sunday. Shengli Breakfast: The students' canteen around NCKU. Generations of NCKU alumni still dream about it. sesame flatbread: A flat bread with sesame seeds. Shengli Breakfast serves it into the small hours.

油條：長條的油炸麵食，勝利早點和豆漿一起賣。 豆漿：黃豆做的飲料。勝利早點配燒餅、油條賣。 飯桌仔：十幾道家常菜一字排開，指哪道吃哪道。 鮮魚湯：詹記的招牌湯：鱸魚骨、蛤蜊與現切魚片，現點現做。

fried cruller: A long fried dough stick. Shengli Breakfast serves it with soy milk. soy milk: A drink made from soybeans. Shengli Breakfast serves it with flatbread and crullers. rice table: A dozen home dishes laid out. Point at what you want. fish soup: Zhan-ji's signature soup: sea-bass bones, clams, and fresh fillets, made to order.

蚵仔煎：在台南，蚵仔煎裡的配菜一定是豆芽菜。 必比登推介：一種餐廳推薦。詹記是東區最新的必比登推介。

oyster omelet: In Tainan, the vegetable in an oyster omelet is always bean sprouts. Bib Gourmand: A restaurant award. Zhan-ji is the East District's newest Bib Gourmand.

實景照片

Photos on site

大東夜市 Dadong Night Market

大東夜市的招牌高高立著，晚上亮起彩色的燈。旁邊大大的旗子寫著「燒酒螺」，是用米酒和辣椒炒的小螺，邊走邊吸著吃，是臺南夜市的經典小吃。

The tall sign of Dadong Night Market lights up in bright colors after dark. The big flag beside it is for shao jiu luo, small sea snails cooked with rice wine and chili. People suck them out of the shell as they walk.

夜市入口的霓虹招牌 Neon signs at the entrance

走進夜市，高高的「大東夜市 DADONG NIGHT MARKET」霓虹燈柱閃著彩色的光，旁邊是一排排亮橘色招牌：燒酒螺、魚蛋……每一攤都想讓你第一眼就看到。

At the entrance, a tall neon tower spells out Dadong Night Market in bright colors. Rows of orange signs advertise snails in rice wine, fish balls and more, each stall trying to catch your eye first.

攤位走道 Between the stalls

一排排攤車沿著走道排開：芋頭牛奶、西瓜汁、臭豆腐……招牌一個比一個亮。走道不寬，跟著人潮慢慢逛，看到想吃的就停下來。

Rows of food carts line the lanes: taro milk, watermelon juice, stinky tofu and much more, each sign brighter than the last. The lanes are narrow, so walk slowly with the crowd and stop when something looks good.

人潮與飲料攤 Crowds and drink stands

夜市最熱鬧的時候，走道擠滿了人。抬頭看，鳳梨冰茶、甘草芭樂、藥膳排骨……招牌和旗子一路排過去。這裡的人潮就是夜市的樂趣，跟著人群慢慢走就好。

At its busiest, the lanes fill with people. Look up to see sign after sign for pineapple iced tea, guava with licorice powder and herbal pork ribs. The crowd is part of the fun, so just go with the flow.

石板烤肉 Pork on a hot stone

這攤在大鐵板上烤五花肉，招牌寫著「原住民石板烤肉」，靈感來自臺灣原住民在石板上烤肉的作法。烤到油亮微焦，再切成一片片裝盒。

This stall grills thick slices of pork belly on a hot plate. The sign says it follows the way Taiwan's Indigenous peoples cook meat on a heated stone slab. The pork is grilled until shiny and a little crisp, then sliced into a box.

夜市遊戲攤 Carnival games

除了吃，夜市還有遊戲攤：射氣球、套圈圈、打彈珠，玩中了就可以從牆上滿滿的娃娃裡挑一隻帶回家。

Night markets are not only about food. Game stalls let you shoot balloons, toss rings or play pinball, and winners pick a stuffed toy from the wall.

散步路線

Walking route

夜市 Night market夜市晚上才熱鬧，沒有排進白天的散步路線。
Night markets come alive after dark, so they are not on the daytime walking routes.
